tests.title: Only a full Enter hold completes onboarding and persists
tests.objective: Verify physical touch gestures reject incomplete acknowledgement and a full hold durably completes onboarding.
setup: All routes, charts, settings and bonds on this unit are expendable.

steps.action: Record whether USB is initially connected.
steps.expected_result: The initial USB state is recorded for cleanup.

steps.action: Factory-reset with a BOOT hold of at least two seconds.
steps.expected_result: Getting Started is visible after restart.

steps.action: On Getting Started, tap Enter once, double-tap within 250 ms, then hold for about half a second and release. Let each screen refresh finish before the next gesture.
steps.expected_result: Getting Started remains open after each gesture; none completes onboarding.

steps.action: Disconnect USB, hold Power until Powered off is painted, release, wait 10 seconds and press Power to start.
steps.expected_result: Getting Started returns: the incomplete gestures did not save onboarding.

steps.action: Hold Enter for at least one second, keeping it held until Home paints; then release.
steps.expected_result: Home opens while held, unlocked; release causes no extra navigation. Warmup fields may still be dashes.

steps.action: Disconnect USB, hold Power until Powered off is painted, release Power, wait 10 seconds, then press Power to start.
steps.expected_result: The device reaches Home without showing Getting Started.

cleanup: Complete onboarding if interrupted.
Restore the recorded USB connection state. The factory-reset data is intentionally not restored.

tests.title: A custom 17-second interval survives another setting change and restart
tests.objective: Verify exact representation and intentional replacement of custom cadence.
setup: A computer with curl and access to the test LAN.
A controllable 2.4 GHz WPA2 test LAN.
Working credentials for that LAN are saved on the Go.
Access to the router association list and assigned device IP addresses.

steps.action: Create a new evidence directory for this case on the computer. Use its absolute path for <run-dir>. Before each command, replace its placeholders with the case’s actual values and quote paths containing spaces.
steps.expected_result: The case has its own writable evidence directory.

steps.action: Record the current operating mode, lock state and USB connection state. Unlock with a short Power press if needed. Settings paths below start at Main Menu > Settings. Configuration values are captured with the API in the following steps.
steps.expected_result: The original values are recorded for cleanup and the controls are unlocked.

steps.action: Select Main Menu > Operating Mode > Stationary.
steps.expected_result: Stationary is selected.

steps.action:
Read the assigned address from the router association list. Set AGO_URL to this unit, replacing the example IP, and save its configuration:
AGO_URL='http://192.168.1.20'
curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -o <run-dir>/config-original.json
Record About Device serial as <serial>.
steps.expected_result: Saved Wi-Fi is connected and the original GET Config returns a complete JSON object.

steps.action:
Enable local authority:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"configurationControl":"local"}'
Read back with curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from acceptance before continuing.
steps.expected_result: The PUT returns empty HTTP 202; GET Config reports configurationControl=local.

steps.action:
Submit:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"cloudConnection":false}'
Then read curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from HTTP acceptance.
steps.expected_result: Empty HTTP 202 is followed by GET Config containing the requested values.

steps.action:
Submit:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"measurementInterval":17}'
Then read curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from HTTP acceptance.
steps.expected_result: Empty HTTP 202 is followed by GET Config containing the requested values.

steps.action: Open Settings > Operations > Measure Int. Change GPS to Always Off and reopen Measure Int.
steps.expected_result: Operations shows 17s; selected Custom (17s) precedes fixed 3s, 10s, 30s, 60s, 5m, 15m, 1h. Changing GPS preserves 17.

import asyncio, sys, cbor2
from bleak import BleakClient
import ago_protocol as p
async def run():
    q = asyncio.Queue()
    async with BleakClient(sys.argv[1]) as c:
        await c.start_notify(p.CHAR_CONFIG_UUID, lambda _, b: q.put_nowait(bytes(b)))
        await c.write_gatt_char(p.CHAR_CONFIG_UUID, p.encode_command('clear_data'), response=True)
        async def completion():
            while True:
                result = cbor2.loads(await q.get())
                print(result, flush=True)
                if result.get('type') == 'cmd_result' and result.get('cmd') == 'clear_data':
                    if result.get('ok') is not True:
                        raise RuntimeError('Device command failed')
                    return
        await asyncio.wait_for(completion(), timeout=90)
asyncio.run(run())
PY
Immediately inspect a chart before the next scheduled sample.

import asyncio, sys
from bleak import BleakClient
import ago_protocol as p
async def delete():
    target = int(sys.argv[2])
    queue = asyncio.Queue()
    async with BleakClient(sys.argv[1]) as c:

steps.expected_result: The Wi-Fi icon disconnects; no provisioning page or reboot appears.

steps.action: Restore the AP. Rediscover the device through its router entry and GET Config/Measures for up to 90 seconds.
steps.expected_result: The saved network reconnects, both endpoints return 200 and Config matches the pre-outage baseline.

cleanup: Restore AP power even after failure.
If the case stopped before saving config-original.json, restore only the UI state already recorded and report any missing baseline. Otherwise perform the following configuration restoration.
With config-original.json available, return to Stationary if needed and update AGO_URL from the router association list.

With the saved baseline available, enable local authority with curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"configurationControl":"local"}' and confirm it with GET Config before restoring fields.
From config-original.json, restore cloudConnection first and configurationControl last using individual PUT /api/v1/config requests. Confirm each with GET Config within 20 seconds of acceptance.
Restore the recorded operating mode, lock state and USB connection state. Record any restoration failure or unexpectedly changed field.
Close the serial capture after saving the required evidence.
Restore each changed access point to its recorded power state and configuration, including after interruption.

tests.title: Stationary falls back to a second saved network
tests.objective: Verify saved-network selection and failover without provisioning.
setup: All routes, charts, settings and bonds on this unit are expendable.
A controllable WPA2 test access point.
The test access point’s SSID and password.
A computer with a browser and curl.
Access to the router association list and assigned IP addresses.
Two independently controllable DHCP access points with distinct SSIDs.
A computer Wi-Fi scanner that displays signal strength in dBm.

steps.action: Record the computer’s current Wi-Fi network before switching networks for provisioning.
steps.expected_result: The original computer network is recorded for cleanup.

steps.action: Record the test access point’s power state and configuration before changing either. For two access points, record both.
steps.expected_result: The access point baseline is available for cleanup.

steps.action: Factory-reset with a BOOT hold of at least two seconds, complete onboarding with a one-second Enter hold, then select Main Menu > Operating Mode > Stationary. On app setup choose Switch to Wi-Fi and confirm Yes. Join airgradient-<serial> with password cleanair and open http://192.168.4.1/.
steps.expected_result: The Go displays portal setup and the browser shows the credential form.

steps.action: Provision AP A. Turn A off, cold-start and provision AP B when setup opens. Restore A; do not reset between provisioning the two.
steps.expected_result: Both networks are saved.

steps.action: Position A at least 10 dB stronger than B at the unit, verified by a computer scan. Re-enter Stationary and record association plus Local Config.
steps.expected_result: The unit joins A. Failure to establish the signal separation blocks the selection check.

steps.action: Turn A off. Allow 90 seconds for failover, then join B with the computer and GET Config/Measures using the new router address.
steps.expected_result: The unit joins B without provisioning; both endpoints return 200 and configuration is unchanged.

cleanup: Restore both APs and leave the dedicated unit Portable.
Restore each changed access point to its recorded power state and configuration, including after interruption.
Reconnect the computer to its recorded original Wi-Fi network after saving evidence.

from bleak import BleakClient

async def run():

asyncio.run(run())

Poll GET Config for at most 20 seconds after each accepted write.
From config-original.json, restore cloudConnection first and configurationControl last using individual PUT /api/v1/config requests. Confirm each with GET Config within 20 seconds of acceptance.
Restore the recorded operating mode, lock state and USB connection state. Record any restoration failure or unexpectedly changed field.
Close the serial capture after saving the required evidence.

tests.title: A Wi-Fi outage during OTA leaves the source image bootable
tests.objective: Verify loss of the real radio link during flash transfer does not select a partial image and the unit can recover networking after cold power.
setup: A computer with curl and access to the test LAN.
A controllable 2.4 GHz WPA2 test LAN.
Working credentials for that LAN are saved on the Go.
Access to the router association list and assigned device IP addresses.
A USB data cable.
A computer with a serial terminal that supports the native USB Serial/JTAG port at 115200 baud and timestamped logging.

Special handling: attach the specified lab runbook and fixture/client/backend version to the run. This repository does not provide that equipment or its operator controls. If any requirement below is unavailable, record Blocked before executing; a partial run cannot pass.
An expendable unit and an approved Go application image with a recorded checksum and version different from the installed source image.

A controlled OTA backend targeting only this unit, with an attached operator runbook for selecting no-update versus the approved image, observing request/byte progress, throttling an active download without hitting its read timeout, and interrupting it. Include measured upper bounds for transfer completion and failure after interruption, plus source-image restoration instructions.
The OTA backend can leave normal cloud configuration inert during the run, so it cannot overwrite the test settings.
The Go can reach the controlled backend over the test network.

steps.action: Create a new evidence directory for this case on the computer. Use its absolute path for <run-dir>. Before each command, replace its placeholders with the case’s actual values and quote paths containing spaces.
steps.expected_result: The case has its own writable evidence directory.

steps.action: Record the current operating mode, lock state and USB connection state. Unlock with a short Power press if needed. Settings paths below start at Main Menu > Settings. Configuration values are captured with the API in the following steps.
steps.expected_result: The original values are recorded for cleanup and the controls are unlocked.

steps.action: Connect the USB data cable and start timestamped serial capture on the native USB Serial/JTAG port at 115200 baud. Keep capture running through the observations below, reconnecting after a restart when needed.
steps.expected_result: Firmware logs are visible with timestamps before the observations that use them.

steps.action: Select Main Menu > Operating Mode > Stationary.
steps.expected_result: Stationary is selected.

steps.action:
Read the assigned address from the router association list. Set AGO_URL to this unit, replacing the example IP, and save its configuration:
AGO_URL='http://192.168.1.20'
curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -o <run-dir>/config-original.json
Record About Device serial as <serial>.
steps.expected_result: Saved Wi-Fi is connected and the original GET Config returns a complete JSON object.

steps.action:
Enable local authority:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"configurationControl":"local"}'
Read back with curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from acceptance before continuing.
steps.expected_result: The PUT returns empty HTTP 202; GET Config reports configurationControl=local.

steps.action:
Submit:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"cloudConnection":true,"measurementInterval":10}'
Poll curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" for at most 20 seconds from acceptance.
steps.expected_result: HTTP 202 is followed by the requested values in GET Config.

steps.action: Record About Device firmware version as the source version. Warm sensors for five minutes and save a current Home photo and GET Measures response.
steps.expected_result: The source version is known and normal sensing/local HTTP are available.

steps.action: Stage and throttle the approved image using the backend runbook. Wait up to 65 minutes for the hourly check. Once backend bytes and Updating firmware confirm a committed transfer, turn the test AP off before the final byte.
steps.expected_result: The download fails within the attached runbook's failure deadline and does not boot the staged image.
evidence: Save backend byte count at interruption and the OTA terminal log.

steps.action: Remove the staged update using the backend runbook, restore the AP, disconnect USB and cold-restart with Power (release after Powered off, wait 10 seconds, then press Power). Reconnect USB for logs and allow 90 seconds after Home for saved-network connection. Check About Device and local GETs.
steps.expected_result: The original source version boots, saved Wi-Fi connects and GET Config/Measures return 200. Automatic reconnect immediately after committed OTA link loss is not guaranteed by current firmware; cold recovery is the required check.
